# Bundled spreadsheet dependency

- ExcelJS 4.4.0, official browser distribution (`dist/exceljs.min.js`)
- Upstream: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs
- Published package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/exceljs/v/4.4.0
- Source tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/exceljs/-/exceljs-4.4.0.tgz
- SHA-256 of this exact bundle: `7e49da68588e250dbb8bba190d2caa8ab3787cc0284bda1d8b2f805c4df742c9`
- Licence: upstream MIT; see [EXCELJS-LICENSE.txt](EXCELJS-LICENSE.txt). The original bundle is unmodified and retains its upstream notices.

The packaged byte-for-byte distribution matches the library used by the original WinMatch web exchange tool. It is loaded locally; no CDN calls are necessary. To replace it on a future release, use the official package's matching browser bundle and corresponding licence file.
